name: 48141 · Inkster, MI
findings: ZIP 48141 (Inkster) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48141 (Inkster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48141 (Inkster) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
